title: impact
limitations: Pattern matches are review prompts, not proven vulnerabilities.
Only added lines in tracked changes are scanned; untracked and binary files are outside scope.
This does not replace tests or security review. Avoid confidential input in shared reports.

impact.limitations: This is a static name-based heuristic. It cannot confirm the test exercises the changed lines, cannot detect indirect calls or dynamic dispatch, and cannot substitute for runtime coverage or manual review.
